full_details: Rehearsal was short. You were for Blackfriars, then the Bell. At Field's the Plutarch hung damp, like washing. You read a forme of Caesar where it hung, and a turned letter ringed in brown ink. Field asked fourteen shillings unbound, and his Holinshed home by Whitsun. You paid the fourteen and promised nothing. He said an error acquires company. The next sheet was Theseus. You carried the sheets off flat. At the Bell you marked the thimble for Susanna, not before the Monday after Rogation Sunday, which is the twenty-sixth. Edmund's letter went as it was written. Gilbert's parcel came back with you. Anne's letter gave Hamnet a water-wheel, Judith a dispute and a second ballad, and Susanna a fault she will tell you herself. You left the Bell, walked north, and were at the Theatre in time. You spoke Egeon in Errors. At home five lines of Theseus stayed, and no play came of them.
one_sentence: You paid Field fourteen shillings, and Hobbins took the thimble, two letters, and tenpence.
title: Fourteen shillings, and the thimble gone
